# @three-ws/skill-license

> On-chain skill licenses for agents — each purchased skill is a 1/1 SPL NFT plus a deterministic SkillLicense PDA. Mint, verify, and read trustless skill access in one import, no database required.

@three-ws/skill-license is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/skill-license`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/skill-license/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/skill-license/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/skill-license/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/skill-license/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
